Overview

Albany is a city in NY with a population of 98,000. New York’s capital with the Empire State Plaza, SUNY Albany, and the Hudson River. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.9.
